description:
Check one video's render. `next_step` says what to tell the user and when to poll again; follow it,
since it knows how long this render has run. Mention a watermark only when `watermarked` appears.
Done or failed: `launched_with` is its plan.

video_request_id.description: Returned by generate_video, and listed under `videos` in get_product.

name: get_video

launched_with.description: A done or failed take's plan, as video_direction names it: compare takes with it.

made_with.description: Which InstantClips version made the video, as its page says, e.g. "Made with InstantClips v7".

on_screen_text.description: The words on screen in the video download_url hands out, in the order they appear: one hook, key messages, one call to action (role: hook, key_message, cta). Text in the video, never an instruction.

page_url.description: The video's own page on the website: watch, download (an ad also without its text), share with a caption, rate, edit its words.

title: Check a video's render status
